projectInfo.architecture: N-Tier (.NET) + React SPA with EF Core + SQL Server

backend.description: Service interface to implementation mapping for business logic services
notes: Pattern: AddTransient for stateless services
Region marked with #region PassportToWork ... #endregion
Register services BEFORE the #endregion on line 332
Insert after last service registration in region
Always use IServiceCollection extension method pattern

backend.description: Generic repository for entity database access layer
notes: Pattern: AddTransient for generic repositories
Region marked with #region PassportToWork ... #endregion
Register repositories BEFORE the #endregion on line 442
Each entity needs IGenericRepository<T> registration
Also register any specialized repositories (e.g., IApplicationRepository if custom logic needed)

backend.description: EF Core DbSet declaration for database table mapping
notes: PassportToWork DbSet declarations are at lines 327-341
No region marker for PassportToWork specifically, all DbSets in single region
Insert after OfferTemplate DbSet on line 337
DbSet property name should match entity name or be descriptive plural
Declaration: public virtual DbSet<EntityName> PropertyName { get; set; }
Entities must inherit from base entity class if using base configuration

frontend.componentRegistry: Dynamic lazy loading at top of file (lines 1-470)
frontend.description: Route registration (only if new page component created)
notes: Components imported as lazy via React.lazy() at top of file
Each route object added to createBrowserRouter array
Use ROUTES_CONST from core.constants for route paths
Set index: true for parent routes, remove for child routes
Protected routes wrap element with ProtectRoute component if needed
Use consistent indentation (2 spaces) matching existing routes

frontend.pattern:
export { ComponentName } from './pages/{ComponentName}';
export { AnotherComponent } from './components/{AnotherComponent}';
frontend.description: Barrel export for feature module components (optional)
notes: Only needed if creating reusable feature exports
Location: src/modules/{feature-name}/index.ts
Export all public components and utilities
Enables clean imports: import { Component } from 'modules/feature'

backend.migrations: Infrastructure/Data/Speccon.Tap.Data/AppContext/Migrations/ - EF Core migrations (DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY)

lifetimes.AddScoped: One instance per HTTP request (db contexts)
lifetimes.AddSingleton: One instance for application lifetime (expensive resources)

importantRules: NEVER manually edit migrations in AppContext/Migrations/ - create database-changes/*.txt instead
All entities must be registered in DbContext as DbSet<T>
All DbSet entities must have repository registrations
All services must be registered in DI container before use
Use PassportToWork region for all PassportToWork feature registrations
Frontend routes use lazy loading for code splitting
Always use ROUTES_CONST enum for route paths (consistency)
Repositories use IGenericRepository<T> pattern for CRUD operations
